Wonderful birthday party at Elisa!
Oct 2023 • Family
My husband's families and friends from Canada travelled to Vietnam and we chose Elisa Floating Restaurant to celebrate birthday for my mother-in-law and on of our best friends after researching many restaurants for 3 conditions: good food, good service, and traditional decorations.

I was connected to the manager named Thang Pham and he was so amazing. He supported me to choose the menu which had varied ingredients and tasty. Waiters and waitresses at the restaurant were also very supportive, cheerful, and amazing. They served the food fast and they were very patient to answer all our questions and support our needs wholeheartedly. Everyone in my group enjoyed the dinner a lot! There was also a music band every night and the singers sang beautifully.

When we arrived, the staff at the restaurant knew that we would celebrate two birthdays so they arranged a small parade with candles, music, and mascot secretly to surprise the whole team! It was so fun and touching to receive extra care for our birthday celebration. We were also given free ice creams! We had a wonderful dinner with a lot of laughs and surprises. Thank you so much for your super wonderful dedicated services, Mr. Thang Pham and your team! We never forget that special night!

Amazing dinner in floating boat Elisa
Aug 2023 • Family
We initially went to take pictures of the boat, since we saw it from far away and looked beautiful. We then asked if we could have a drink and they were happy to have us on board, so we entered the ship. It looks fantastic, we ordered a drink and meanwhile we had a walk on the sun deck. The ship is just beautiful and very well located in a way that you see most of Saigon from the boat, simply stunning views. When the drinks arrived, we asked if we could have a look at the food menu, we saw it and everything looked delicious, so we decided to have dinner even though it was a bit early for us 18:30. This was the best decision that we made. We had soup, spring rolls (shrimp ones), goose and beef tenderloin with mashed potatoes. I cannot describe in words how f***** amazing the food was, just speechless. Regarding the service, they were very attentive and professional. I asked the waiter to let the cook know that we were amazed by the quality of the food. Then the manager came to ask us about the experience and about our holiday trip. 
Regarding the price, it obviously is not comparable to street food or a cheap restaurant, but quality/price. It’s definitely a 10/10. 

A must try if you ever go to Saigon. 

An unfortunate experience.

Pretty average
Apr 2019 • Family
Chose this restaurant based on how amazing it looked when we drove past. Booked without reading reviews (would not have come had we read these...).

The restaurant is very impressive, we dined on the top deck and the views are beautiful.

It was pretty quiet on the night we went, but there was a lot of staff working. Is quite unnerving as there were always about 3 or 4 people standing watching your every move. You would think having this many staff on would lead to excellent service but sadly it did not. Food took an age to come out and it even took about 30 minutes after being given menus before they took our order.

As foreigners, it seemed like the local people were getting far more attentive service, whether this was true or not or just the impression I got, I am not sure but it did feel that way.

Food is a bit out there for me, some really weird items. The food we did order was of ok standard, neither good nor bad.

It ended up being pretty much the most expensive meal we had during our two week stay in Vietnam, not sure if we were charged the foreign prices as others have suggested. 

Could not recommend to anyone else. Great views and part of me is glad we went as it is an impressive ship and location but I am certain there are far better restaurants around that would be half the price.

ZERO stars!! Foreigners beware!! DO NOT EAT HERE!!!!!!
Jan 2019 • Couples
Our hotel booked us a table at this restaurant we went without reading the reviews. BIG mistake!!!! They usher you quickly on the boat and it took 5 different waiters to seat you with menus. Food on the menu is nothing I’ve ever seen before or would ever want to eat. I ordered two simple appetizers ( egg rolls and spring rolls), a bottle of Champagne, and an entrée. The waiter said, “that takes an hour to cook, pick this other dish”. My appetizers came out, the food was cold and absolutely horrible. I can not even explain how terrible the food is. I then asked about my entrée, ... the entree I picked and if he was bringing what he wanted, I did not want it. Well, 10 mins later, he brings the entrée he suggested that was quicker to cook. I told them I did not want it and do not put it on my table. The waiter then calls another waiter, they spoke in viet (which I understood). They were mocking Foreigners and degrading them; don’t be mistaken by a smile as they walk away speaking in Vietnamese. He then threw the plate on our table and said, “ tough, I don’t care if you want it or not, and I don’t care if you eat it or not. You will pay for this entrée”. Then more waiters and waitresses walk by speaking Vietnamese and making remarks. From a person who is fluent in Vietnamese, you can not imagine. I felt, all they want is to overcharge foreigners. Upper management staff ( the man that threw the entree on our table) are extremely rude and their behavior is unacceptable. The reviews are either good or extremely bad, I question the good reviews???The response to the customers reviews from their management team is crazy as my experience was true to the upset reviews. I can not believe anyone in the service industry would behave in such a low despicable manner. Hospitality and etiquette classes would help. This is definitely the WORST experience we had in HCMC. I DO NOT RECOMMEND ANYONE TO COME HERE!!!!!!!!!!

Two menu prices
Nov 2018 • Couples
The boat looks beautiful. We couldnt resist. We wandered aboard and asked if it was ok if we just had a beer. We were sent up in a lift to the top deck and the layout of the restaurant looked superb. However, we appearwd most unwelcome. It took four staff to decide where we could sit. There was no one else on board. We were eventually given a table to one side. A menu was produced and two saigon beers were ordered at 39000vnd each. When the bill arrived it was for 148000vnd. Obviously we queried the amount as it was double what we expected. Three different people were called to assist and a new menu was produced showing saigon beer at 68000vnd each. Tax 10%. Math still doesnt work. This was a different menu and we were told we shouldnt have been given the other one. A staff member was blamed for the error and we were still expected to pay the inflated amount. Next a compromise of 104000vnd was offered but as this issue had becone a matter of principal i refused to pay above the menu price i was given. Eventually the original menu surfaced (photo attached) and the assistant manager, full of apologies, accepted that the error was on their part. I still have the original bill that i was given. A reminder of double standards that can exist for us stupid uneducated westerners. Did u ever feel you were being bullied?

Quite possibly the worst eating experience I have had
Oct 2018 • Family
I am posting this review 2 weeks after visiting Elisa as the duty manager had promised to send a written explanation as to the appalling experience we suffered. 2 weeks have elapsed and no such explanation has been received - I would say that it is typical of the establishment.
In short, it was my wife's birthday, the food was served cold, despite previous assurances there was no dessert apart from fruit or berries available, we were overcharged for items that we did not receive and were even charged for wet towels that we also did not receive. When this was brought to managers attention he simply refused to acknowledge this and after some lenghthy debate he finally conceded that the staff were in error and blamed it on the newness of the staff and not having been trained correctly.
He promised to send me a full explanation of the circumstances but after 2 weeks, nothing.
I strongly believe that they try to take advantage of none Vietnamese patrons. Please take note of other reviews / postings.
There are so many other good and curteous places to eat in HCMC.
